title: How CJP’s 'Jantar Mantar 2.0' call outgrew its venue, spread across cities
content: Protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar occurred in multiple Indian cities over perceived electoral roll irregularities. In Delhi, over 7,000 people were detained while attempting to gather at Jantar Mantar. Similar protests took place in Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Ahmedabad, resulting in hundreds of detentions. Police cited safety and law-and-order concerns, leading to heavy barricading and police monitoring.

title: New York Mayor Mamdani says companies like Netflix will now pay if you can't cancel
content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's Click-to-Cancel rule is now in effect, requiring businesses to let customers cancel subscriptions the same way they signed up. Enforced by the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection, it covers streaming services like Netflix, Amazon Prime and Disney+, as well as gym memberships. Violations carry civil penalties starting at $525 and possible refunds. New Yorkers can file complaints through a new online city portal.

title: Michael Bloomberg’s $1bn gift made Johns Hopkins medical school tuition-free
content: In a groundbreaking move, Johns Hopkins University revealed a $1 billion contribution from Bloomberg Philanthropies to significantly improve financial assistance for graduate students. This generous funding extends free tuition to medical students from households earning under $300,000, while those from families with incomes up to $175,000 can access support for both tuition and living expenses.

title: US death row inmate Christa Pike back in prison from hospital after failed execution
content: Christa Pike, a Tennessee death row inmate, has returned to prison after a failed execution attempt. The September 30 incident resulted in her needing medical care after the lethal injection process failed. Governor Bill Lee has ordered a review of the state's execution procedures following this incident. Pike had been sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of her classmate, Colleen Slemmer.

title: ‘Amitabh Bachchan is hero for us, but he’s allowed to be human’: Abhishek on his father
content: Amitabh Bachchan is celebrating his 84th birthday on October 11 with numerous wishes from admirers. On the occasion, here's recalling the time when Abhishek Bachchan shared insights about their family dynamics and his father's dual role as a star and family man. He also spoke about how his parents feel about his career and how seeing his father at home despite being a superstar, taught him to stay detach from fame early on in life.

title: Steve McQueen’s former Malibu home bought for $8.35m now lists for $16.995m
content: Steve McQueen's iconic Malibu beach house passed through several ownership hands before receiving significant renovations from its latest buyers. Boasting oceanfront decks and private beach access, this esteemed property is nestled within an exclusive gated community. Initially bought for $8.35 million, it was revamped and relisted at $16.995 million, eventually selling for $13.6 million in September 2023, with its connection to McQueen and MacGraw continuing to garner interest.

title: New York fire fundraiser topped $100,000; state AG seeks $71,539 in unpaid funds
content: Hailey Bodah, a young New Yorker, faced unimaginable loss when a fire claimed the lives of her father and four sisters. In the wake of this tragedy, generous relatives raised over $100,000 to help her. However, legal issues emerged regarding the management of the funds, with the New York Attorney General’s office demanding the return of over $71,000.

title: Jeff Bezos invests $100 million to turn vacant land into parks in eight US cities
content: Jeff Bezos is allocating $100 million to convert neglected urban land into parks in eight American cities. The funding aims to revitalize vacant lots and industrial sites while enhancing community access to nature. Specific projects include restoring public spaces in Cleveland, creating parks in Indianapolis, and improving green areas in Salt Lake City. Cities such as Los Angeles and Little Rock will benefit from new recreational and gathering spaces.

title: California flying saucer house built in 1969 lists for nearly $1.5 million
content: Nestled in California's stunning landscape, the Donaldson Futuro is a captivating flying saucer-shaped home now listed for $1.495 million. Constructed in 1969, this architectural marvel exemplifies space-age design and carries historical weight. After languishing in neglect, it was expertly restored by Milford Wayne Donaldson, preserving its mid-century essence while integrating modern comforts. This is a unique opportunity to embrace a landmark of architectural history.

title: Travis Kelce warns NFL as Patrick Mahomes and Chiefs dominate in 2026
content: Travis Kelce sent a confident message to the NFL after the Kansas City Chiefs improved to 4-0 in the 2026 season. Sharing a photo with Patrick Mahomes and Xavier Worthy on Instagram Stories, Kelce wrote, “Just the beginning!!” Mahomes and running back Kenneth Walker III have powered the Chiefs' offence, while the team continues to strengthen its defence. Kansas City returns after its Week 5 bye to face the Los Angeles Chargers.

title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026: Confirmed matches, start time and how to watch
content: WWE Money in the Bank 2026 is set for October 10 at the Smoothie King Center in New Orleans. This thrilling event will showcase five confirmed matches, featuring top wrestlers and diverse match formats. Fans can anticipate an exhilarating title defense as Roman Reigns faces LA Knight first. To accommodate international viewers, various start times have been designated, while fans in the US can catch the live broadcast on ESPN.

title: ‘Where is he?’ CJP seeks Dipke’s release ahead of grandma’s last rites on Sunday
content: The Cockroach Janta Party is seeking the release of its leader Abhijeet Dipke following his detention by Delhi Police. Dipke's family wishes to speak with him before his grandmother's last rites, scheduled for Sunday morning. Despite police claims of informing him about his grandmother's death, CJP continues to question his current whereabouts. Additionally, CJP has called for the immediate release of all other detained leaders.

title: Landlord wanted tenant out for law office; Delhi HC rejects tenant's objections
content: Two landlords, who were practising advocates, said they needed the rented premises to set up a law office. The tenant argued that the landlords had changed their stated purpose for seeking possession and already had other properties that could be used for their professional work. The tenant opposed the eviction and applied for leave to defend.

title: Couple with legs chained found dead in Tapi river, Dhule police suspect suicide
content: Shyam Patil and his wife Sapna were discovered dead in the Tapi river in Dhule. Their bodies were chained together, indicating a possible suicide after their last phone call. Local residents reported seeing a motorcycle parked near the river before the discovery. Shyam had contacted his brother-in-law shortly before their presumed drowning, stating that everything was over.

title: Delhi protests: CJP stir against CEC triggers political face-off - top developments
content: Delhi Police detained upwards of 37000 demonstrators on Saturday, protesting against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged voter-list manipulation, insisting on his resignation. Prominent political figures such as Arvind Kejriwal and Mamata Banerjee were among those arrested. Opposition members criticized the government for suppressing free speech by halting protests and imposing internet shutdowns, while the BJP defended their stance, calling the demonstrations a ploy to incite chaos.

title: Earthquake of magnitude 4.2 hits Uttarakhand's Uttarkashi
content: A 4.2-magnitude earthquake struck Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand, on Saturday night, with its epicentre around 2 km northwest of the district headquarters and a focal depth of 11 km.

title: 'Ab jawaab bhi dena padega': CJP claims member ‘brutally assaulted’ by Delhi Police
content: Cockroach Janta Party claimed that its Mumbai lead, Pranay Ahire, was assaulted during a protest in Delhi. The party stated that he is currently receiving medical treatment in the hospital. CJP criticized the police's actions as a violation of democratic rights and vowed to challenge the incident. Additionally, other CJP leaders were detained by police ahead of the protest demanding the Chief Election Commissioner's resignation.

title: 'I think it should be taken out': Rahane joins calls to abolish Impact Player rule
content: Ajinkya Rahane has raised significant concerns regarding the Impact Player rule in the Indian Premier League. He argues that this rule stifles the development of all-rounders in Indian cricket, restricting their vital opportunities on the field. Although some teams have exploited this rule for higher scores, it diminishes the role of bowlers and all-rounders.

title: Actor Imran Khan among several detained in Mumbai for supporting CJP protest
content: Actor Imran Khan was among many detained by Mumbai Police during a protest supporting the Cockroach Janata Party. Protesters gathered near Nana Chowk, leading to their detention as police restricted movement in the area. August Kranti Maidan, intended for the demonstration, was locked down and heavily guarded. Separate protests also occurred with Vanchit Bahujan Aghadi workers being detained at Hutatma Chowk.

title: Happy Shardiya Navratri 2026: Best wishes, quotes, messages
content: As Shardiya Navratri draws near, families nationwide are immersing themselves in the joy of nine festive nights. Temples gleam with decorations, garba spaces come alive, and heartfelt greetings ripple through communities. Messages of love and support are exchanged among friends and colleagues, highlighting unity and devotion. This season brings everyone together, reinstating cherished traditions and sharing blessings in vibrant, meaningful ways.

title: Rob Parker criticises undefeated Vikings as offense struggles to score touchdowns
content: The Minnesota Vikings are 4-0, but Rob Parker believes their poor offense makes them the NFL’s weakest unbeaten team. Two victories without an offensive touchdown have raised concerns, even as their defense and kicker Will Reichard keep delivering results. Minnesota now needs to improve its attack to prove its perfect start reflects genuine strength.

title: ‘He is somewhat similar to me’: Sehwag says Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is in his prime
content: Virender Sehwag draws parallels between his explosive batting style and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's fearless gameplay. The 15-year-old prodigy has made waves in T20Is, showcasing an impressive strike rate and accumulating runs effortlessly. Sehwag emphasises that age should take a backseat to performance at higher levels of cricket, especially with seasoned competitors like Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma vying for opening positions.

title: ‘To be finalised in line with changed circumstances’: Piyush Goyal on India-US trade deal
content: India and the US are finalizing their interim trade agreement framework, as circumstances have changed since February. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal indicated that negotiations would consider recent shifts in the US tariff landscape. Trade talks are also progressing with other countries, including Canada and Mexico. Goyal emphasized the need for legal expertise in negotiating comparative advantage for Indian goods.

title: ‘Shame on you': Video of heated exchange between CJP leaders and flyers goes viral
content: A video emerged showing Cockroach Janta Party co-convenor Saurav Das during a tense exchange on a flight. The incident involved police detaining party leaders at Indira Gandhi International Airport, prompting a protest. CJP members were arriving for a planned demonstration at Jantar Mantar against the Election Commission of India. Founder Abhijeet Dipke engaged with police, expressing defiance during the encounter.

title: Teacher denied gratuity for working past 60; court orders payment with 6% interest
content: A woman joined an educational institution in Faizabad as an assistant teacher on August 16, 1992. She continued working there until March 31, 2019, when she retired. However, the institution declined to pay her gratuity, arguing that the prescribed retirement age was 60 and she had remained in service until she was 62.

title: Builder denied disabled parking to Rs 1.03 crore flat buyer; RERA orders relief
content: In one such case, a woman and her family bought a 3BHK ( 3 Bedrooms, Hall, Kitchen) from a builder in Bengaluru for Rs 1.03 crore. The builder promised two specially enabled parking spaces, and it was supposedly one of the property's key attractions. The builder's brochure and terms clearly referred to these parking facilities. However, he failed to deliver on that commitment.

title: Suspended! How a six-month ban could kill Ronaldo’s Portugal 1,000th-goal dream
content: Cristiano Ronaldo has apologised for his Portugal walkout and accepted that disciplinary action may follow, with the Portuguese Football Federation weighing a potential ban of one to six months. While the decision could affect his availability for upcoming international fixtures, the Al-Nassr forward has continued scoring, reaching 980 career goals. Ronaldo reportedly hopes to achieve the 1,000-goal milestone in a Portugal shirt, making the suspension particularly significant.

title: ‘Another Jantar Mantar’: AAP workers gherao police station after Kejriwal’s detention
content: former chief minister had been under police surveillance at his residence since morning . he was detained when he tried to leave to join the protest against alleged irregularities in the electoral process . party convener arvind Kejriwal, national media in-charge and anurag Dhanda were detained amid protests over alleged vote theft .

title: 'Ukraine should get new prez': Trump targets Zelenskyy after diesel deal with Russia
content: president Donald Trump meets with president Volodymyr Zelenskyy on sunday . he said the war with Russia could have been prevented had he been US president in 2022 . the president also criticised the decision to ease restrictions on Russian diesel supplies amid elevated US fuel prices .

title: Suvendu eyes Bengal sweep: Can TMC, Congress unite to challenge BJP?
content: CM Suvendu Adhikari reiterated the target after his party swept both seats . the BJP may win handsomely, but it is up to the Opposition to put up a spirited fight . bypolls have usually favoured the ruling party .

title: Mamata, Kejriwal and 7,000 protesters released; CJP leaders still in detention
content: former chief minister Mamata Banerjee, former Kerala chief minister Pinarayi Vijayan, AAP convenor Arvind Kejriwal and former Tripura chief minister manik Sarkar among the opposition leaders detained . all four have since been released .

title: Saudi airport attacked again: Missile strikes passenger terminal, many injured
content: airport official says air traffic at the airport had been suspended . three people, including a pilot, were killed in what has become a new front in the expanding Iran war . dozens of ambulances were seen rushing to the site after the airpoo .

title: Delhi protests: SC to hear plea seeking contempt action against authorities on Sunday
content: the plea will be heard on Sunday by a bench of justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana . it seeks contempt proceedings against Union Home Secretary Govind Mohan, Delhi Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar and D Thara . petition alleges authorities deliberately failed to comply with the court’s directions .

title: 'Modi destroying democracy': Rahul slams PM over Delhi protest crackdown
content: the 'Chhatron Ki Goonj' event in Chennai was part of the congress's nationwide campaign . 'they are silencing voices as you saw in Delhi. the entire city was shutdown, internet was shutdown. police was beating students,' Rahul said .

title: Stage set for Sunday showdown: CJP to march again tomorrow; traffic advisory issued
content: police have issued an advisory warning commuters of possible disruptions across several key roads and intersections in the national capital . the new call for mobilisation comes after more than 7,000 protesters were detained across Delhi on Saturday, according to police sources .

title: 'My message to students: you have nothing to fear. We are standing with you': Rahul
content: opposition leader says 'there is no force in this world that is going to stop Modi from facing justice' . he says the BJP unleashed its own goondas to thrash students in new Delhi . the opposition has condemned the action against protesters .

title: 'Fight should be face-to-face': CM Yogi accepts Akhilesh's Ayodhya challenge
